regularCleaning.title: Regular Cleaning
regularCleaning.description: Keep your home shining week after week with our Regular Cleaning service. Designed for families, professionals, and anyone with a busy schedule, we ensure every visit keeps your home tidy, sanitized, and guest-ready. A consistent solution for comfort and peace of mind.
regularCleaning.recommended: Recommended for busy homes that need consistent upkeep — ideal for families, professionals, or anyone who loves a spotless space.

bathrooms: Cleaning and sanitizing tubs, shower and toilets
kitchen: Cleaning inside and outside of microwave

moveInOut.title: Move In/Out Cleaning
moveInOut.description: Moving can be stressful — let us handle the cleaning! Our Move In/Out Cleaning ensures your old or new home is spotless from top to bottom. We deep clean floors, bathrooms, kitchens, and every surface so you can move confidently into a fresh, sanitized environment.
moveInOut.recommended: Recommended for tenants, landlords, or homeowners preparing for a move — ensures every inch is perfectly clean before or after moving day.

main: Deep cleaning of all rooms and surfaces
Cleaning inside cabinets, drawers, and closets
Wiping down doors, trim, and baseboards
Removing any leftover debris or trash

notes: Homes/Apartments must be empty for service, furnished homes/apartments will be charged as a Deep Clean
Any trash left in the home will incur an extra charge

deepCleaning.title: Deep Cleaning
deepCleaning.description: Our Deep Cleaning goes beyond the surface to remove built-up dirt, dust, and grime from every corner of your home. We scrub, disinfect, and refresh neglected areas like baseboards, tiles, and appliances, giving your space a true reset and a healthy, renewed feel.
deepCleaning.recommended: Recommended for homes that need a complete refresh or haven't been cleaned in a while. Perfect before events, seasonal changes, or as preparation for regular maintenance cleanings.

main: Hand washing or wiping baseboards and doors
Hand wash window sills and inside of windows
Hand wash or wipe outside of cabinets in kitchen and bathrooms
Vacuuming and sweeping under beds and furniture if accessible

additionalServices: Clean interior of windows or blinds

officeCleaning.title: Office Cleaning
officeCleaning.description: Create a clean, organized, and productive work environment with our Office Cleaning service. We disinfect desks, sanitize restrooms, and keep common areas spotless so your team and clients enjoy a professional, healthy atmosphere every day.
officeCleaning.recommended: Recommended for offices, coworking spaces, and business suites seeking a clean, healthy, and productive environment.

main: Wiping down glass doors and touch surfaces

commercialCleaning.title: Commercial Cleaning
commercialCleaning.description: Our Commercial Cleaning keeps your business looking professional and inviting. From small shops to large facilities, we clean floors, windows, and high-traffic areas to maintain a spotless appearance that enhances your brand and customer experience.
commercialCleaning.recommended: Recommended for stores, restaurants, gyms, and facilities needing regular professional cleaning to impress customers and staff.

daily: Wipe down and disinfect all touch surfaces
Empty waste bins, replace liners and wash when needed
Wipe chairs, tables, desks, and other types of furniture
Dust chairs, tables, desks, and other types of furniture
Collect all garbage, bottles, papers, etc. from the front entrance
Ensure all areas are cleaned and arranged neatly
Spot clean painted surfaces and walls
Remove fingerprints and marks from door frames and light switches
Polish handles on cabinets and doors
Clean automatic glass doors inside and out
bathroomKitchen: Wipe down and disinfect all touch surfaces
Mop/clean kitchen and bathroom floors with disinfectants
Remove splash marks from partitions around sinks and from walls
Dust the tops of mirrors, frames and cubicles
Clean, sanitize and polish faucets of all sinks
Empty trash bins, wipe down if needed and replace liners as needed
Wipe hand towel dispensers and hand dryers
Stock toilet paper, facial tissues, hand soap and hand towels
Vacuum and mop all hard floors
Spot clean internal glass in doors
Disinfect and clean toilets and urinals
Polish handles on cabinets and doors

postConstruction.title: Post Construction Cleaning
postConstruction.description: After renovation or construction, we remove dust, debris, and residue with precision. Our Post-Construction Cleaning leaves every surface spotless and ready to use, transforming your project from a work site to a clean, polished space.
postConstruction.recommended: Recommended for homeowners, contractors, and property managers who want to eliminate dust and debris after renovation or construction. Perfect to prepare spaces for move-in or final inspection.

main: Removing dust, debris, and construction residue
Cleaning inside cabinets, drawers, and closets
